subject: general
question: What was the objective of "Arya Samaj" founded by "Swami Dayanand Saraswati"?

options.text: To encourage the practice of barter trade

solution:
The correct answer is __**To reform Hinduism.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Arya Samaj** was founded by **Swami Dayanand Saraswati** in **1875** in **Bombay, **India.
 
• The main objective of Arya Samaj was to reform Hinduism</st
